verdict.rationale: OpenCode's docs say you can use any LLM provider by configuring that provider's API key. Account-login flows (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Plus/Pro) are documented as separate options, so key-based auth is a real alternative to logging in. The evidence for key-based auth itself is a single brief docs line. missing for 10: detailed docs on how keys are stored or configured (env vars, auth command, config file), whether OpenCode Zen or OpenCode's own services accept API keys without an account, independent hands-on corroboration of key-based setup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login

citations.quote: With OpenCode you can use any LLM provider by configuring their API keys.
